item.title: etcd Debug Trace Credential Leak / Improper Authentication (CVE-2021-28235)
item.description: Critical severity (CVSS 9.8) — network · CVE-2021-28235. Status: Weaponized (lab script runs the whole chain and prints recovered credentials; the follow-on authenticated access uses those credentials). Affects: etcd (etcd-io), including the debug HTTP handlers served alongside the client API on port 2379; relevant to Kubernetes clusters whose control plane data lives in etcd. Tags: etcd, Kubernetes, authentication bypass, credential disclosure, debug endpoint, gRPC tracing, pprof, CWE-287, unauthenticated.
